name: Halftone dots
summary: Comic halftone dot pattern fading in from one corner, with dots sized by distance from that corner.

params.name: corner
params.note: corner the dots are biggest in

params.name: spacing
params.note: distance between dot centres in px, 24 to 120

params.name: reach
params.note: distance from the corner where the dots vanish, px

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
